daily_wisdom: The biggest mistake aggressive traders make is not cutting losses - it's not riding winners. Cut your losers at your stop, no questions asked, no averaging down. But when a trade works and you hit your conservative target, don't just take all profits and walk away. Sell half, move your stop to breakeven, and let the other half run. Markets trend further than anyone expects. Your best trades of the year will be the ones where you had the discipline to keep half the position working. Size small enough that you can be rational when you're wrong, and patient when you're right.
